before: Editing API tracked changes stamped w:date with milliseconds, accepting or rejecting an item opened with reveal false scrolled to the caret, and some refusals did not name the browser API to use.
after: Editing API tracked changes stamp w:date to the second like editor edits, review writes do not scroll, and comment-author refusals and dialog toolbar reasons name the API to use.
reason: The date change only shortens the value written into existing w:date attributes, which every peer already reads at second precision. Suppressing the caret follow during review writes affects only the local viewport. Diagnostic codes, refusal hints, and toolbar reasons are local messages. The collaboration schema, operation encoding, and shared state do not change.
